integrity: The finite case certificate is independently replayable with Python 3 and SymPy 1.14; a direct exponential-race proof covers the six-edge witness. No Monte Carlo data are used as proofs.
scientific_limitations: Continuous-time irreversible SI on connected simple unweighted graphs; triads are precisely graph triangles; one seed and two targets; finite minimality only through four vertices and through five edges at five vertices; no recovery, independent nonclique hyperedges or weighted networks. External scientific priority validation has not occurred.
title: Smallest triangle-reinforced contagion motif with an arrival-order reversal
